glossary.definition: As used in this section, "bulk storage area" means any area at which at least ten thousand gallons of a hazardous chemical in liquid form or at least fifty thousand pounds of a hazardous chemical in solid form are stored. The term does not include process vessels.
glossary.source_title: Section 3750.12 - Fire marshal rules for placards or labels at bulk storage areas.
